  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "a06725efe2eb38f9a7f3597eb76999557ad50505a60da422a0eb4f00168efe49",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"For every real x and t, both partial derivatives of q exist and satisfy q_t + speed • q_x = 0.","effect_on_target":"The differentiable-initial-profile branch concludes this pointwise equation everywhere, with scalar real values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"There exist real eigenvalues indexed by ι and an ι-indexed real basis of ι → Real such that the coefficient matrix sends each basis vector to its indexed eigenvalue times that vector.","effect_on_target":"Asserts a real eigenbasis for the one-by-one matrix [speed]. The eigenvalues and basis may depend on speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"Every spatial slice is integrable on every bounded interval; every fixed-position flux trace is integrable on every bounded time interval; and the difference of spatial integrals at times t and s equals the time integral from s to t of flux at a minus flux at b, for all real a,b,s,t.","effect_on_target":"The integrable-initial-profile branch concludes all three requirements for flux(state) = speed * state.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"For all real x,t, q(x + speed*t,t) = q(x,0).","effect_on_target":"The common hypothesis of the two regularity branches fixes q along every straight characteristic; equivalently q(x,t) = q(x-speed*t,0).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"The matrix indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates whose sole entry is speed.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the system dimension to one and its coefficient matrix to [speed].","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"LocalDef006","meaning":"An abbreviation for LocalDef009 for a Fin m-indexed vector-valued function.","effect_on_target":"The left side of the equivalence is the vector partial-derivative equation instantiated at m = 1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"LocalDef007","meaning":"An abbreviation for LocalDef010 with real-valued q.","effect_on_target":"The right side of the equivalence requires the two scalar partial derivatives to exist and obey q_t + speed*q_x = 0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"LocalDef008","meaning":"Embeds q into Fin 1 → Real by assigning q(x,t) to its unique coordinate.","effect_on_target":"Identifies the scalar field with a one-component vector field in the equivalence.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"LocalDef009","meaning":"There exist vectors qt and qx that are respectively the derivatives of the time and space slices at t and x, and qt + coefficient.mulVec(qx) = 0.","effect_on_target":"The vector equation includes derivative existence, with witnesses depending on q, the coefficient, x and t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"LocalDef010","meaning":"There exist qt,qx in the real normed vector space E such that the time slice has derivative qt at t, the space slice has derivative qx at x, and qt + speed • qx = 0.","effect_on_target":"Defines the scalar equation and the everywhere equation after specializing E to Real; witnesses may vary with x and t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"LocalDef011","meaning":"Real scalar multiplication on a real-valued function space is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the continuity structure used for derivatives of the one-component vector field; adds no hypothesis on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"LocalDef012","meaning":"Scalar multiplication on any real normed vector space is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supplies a structural prerequisite for scalar derivatives; imposes no additional regularity assumption on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"All three main assertions hold, both conditional regularity assertions hold, and the derivative and integral predicates retain every conjunct.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","meaning":"Retains the normed-field structure and derives nontriviality of the norm from dense norm values.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar field structure required by differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"Differentiable","meaning":"A function is differentiable at every point of its domain over the indicated scalar field.","effect_on_target":"The first regularity hypothesis is differentiability of x ↦ q(x,0) at every real x, without continuity of its derivative.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"Fin","meaning":"Fin n is the type of natural-number indices less than n.","effect_on_target":"Fin 1 has exactly the index 0, so the matrix and vector space have one component.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"Enumerates all indices in Fin n using finRange n.","effect_on_target":"Makes the coefficient multiplication a finite sum over the unique index.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"HMul.hMul","meaning":"Selects the multiplication operation of the supplied heterogeneous multiplication structure.","effect_on_target":"Here it is ordinary real multiplication in speed*t and speed*state.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"Iff","meaning":"Logical equivalence, asserting both implications.","effect_on_target":"The one-component system predicate and scalar predicate are equivalent for every q,x,t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the normed vector space underlying an inner product space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real normed vector space used in the differentiability hypothesis and scalar conclusions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"IntervalIntegrable","meaning":"Integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.","effect_on_target":"Expresses integrability on the bounded interval between arbitrary endpoints, without assuming their order.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure-space instance.","effect_on_target":"All integrability conditions and integrals use the distinguished real measure, conventionally Lebesgue measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"Nat","meaning":"The natural numbers including zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the dimension parameter 1 and its finite index type.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining the seminormed ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Part of the structure path supplying the usual real norm and addition to calculus.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Extracts the norm, additive commutative group and compatible pseudometric from a seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real additive and topological structure needed by the normed space instance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","meaning":"Retains the normed additive group while forgetting commutativity.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real extended-norm structure used for integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, addition and induced pseudometric of a normed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies compatible real structures for scalar differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Builds an extended-normed additive monoid from a normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Integrability of real values uses their ordinary norm regarded as an extended nonnegative norm.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains the ring operations, norm and pseudometric of a normed commutative ring.","effect_on_target":"Carries the standard real norm into the calculus structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the scalar module underlying a normed vector space.","effect_on_target":"Real differentiation and scalar multiplication use the corresponding real-linear structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural numeral through its supplied numeral instance.","effect_on_target":"Interprets dimension 1 as a natural number and the initial time 0 as a real number.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure underlying a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Contributes the usual real topology used for differentiability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"Equips a real-or-complex-like scalar type with its real inner product and underlying real normed space.","effect_on_target":"At Real, this supplies the usual real normed vector space, with scalar multiplication equal to real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"Real","meaning":"The real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Speed, space, time, interval endpoints, scalar states and eigenvalues are real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","meaning":"The real normed field with densely available positive norm sizes.","effect_on_target":"Supports ordinary real differentiation without a restriction on speed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The usual additive commutative group of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition, subtraction and zero for scalar calculus.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"Real.instMul","meaning":"The real multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Makes the flux exactly speed times the state.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"The real numbers viewed as an RCLike field, with identity real part, zero imaginary part, the identity real algebra and completeness.","effect_on_target":"Supplies standard real normed-space structures; does not introduce complex-valued states or eigenvalues.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Real.instZero","meaning":"The real number zero.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the initial time and scalar zero values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"The canonical measure-space instance on Real, conventionally carrying Lebesgue measure; the body delegates its construction to instance inference.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the measure used throughout, rather than quantifying over measures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Real addition with the real norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the usual topology and absolute-value norm for scalar derivatives and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"The ordinary real commutative ring equipped with its compatible norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"The arithmetic and analytic structures in the target refer to the same real operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The ordinary real field with its multiplicative norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar field for real derivatives, modules and integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"The real pseudometric with distance |x-y|.","effect_on_target":"Differentiability uses the usual real topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the designated multiplicative identity while retaining the seminormed commutative ring operations.","effect_on_target":"A structural conversion preserving the real norm, topology and arithmetic used in calculus.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Extracts a uniform space's underlying topology.","effect_on_target":"Makes the real topology in the differentiability hypothesis the metric-induced topology.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","meaning":"Interprets numeral 0 as the supplied zero element.","effect_on_target":"The initial profile is evaluated at real time zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"instHMul","meaning":"Uses a type's multiplication as homogeneous heterogeneous multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Resolves speed*state and speed*t to ordinary real products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural-number numeral as itself.","effect_on_target":"The dimension is exactly the natural number one.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","meaning":"Extracts subtraction, negation and additive monoid structure from an additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supports subtraction in the integral balance law.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"The algebra of a commutative semiring over itself, with identity algebra map and scalar multiplication given by multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Real scalar action on real states is ordinary multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts the scalar action underlying an algebra.","effect_on_target":"Connects the real algebra structure to scalar multiplication in the scalar equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Retains commutative ring operations while forgetting the designated multiplicative identity.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real arithmetic structure required for matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a commutative semiring.","effect_on_target":"Provides the semiring structure used for real modules and bases.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Coerces a function-like object to its underlying dependent function.","effect_on_target":"Allows basis objects to be evaluated at their indices.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"Characteristic values, derivative equations and integral balances are exact equalities, not almost-everywhere equalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification over a witness.","effect_on_target":"Quantifies eigenvalues and a basis, and separately quantifies the two partial-derivative values at each point.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Fintype","meaning":"A finite exhaustive enumeration of a type.","effect_on_target":"Supports finite coordinate sums and finite indexing; the target uses the singleton Fin 1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"The pointwise scalar action on a function space.","effect_on_target":"Multiplying a one-component vector by an eigenvalue multiplies its unique real coordinate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"Selects the supplied addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms x+speed*t and the sums in the scalar and vector derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"Selects the supplied scalar multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms eigenvalue multiples of basis vectors and speed multiples of spatial derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"Selects the supplied subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the order final-time integral minus initial-time integral and left flux minus right flux.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Matrix","meaning":"A matrix is a function from row indices to column indices to entries.","effect_on_target":"The coefficient matrix is a real-valued function on Fin 1 × Fin 1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Matrix.mulVec","meaning":"Matrix-vector multiplication: coordinate i is the finite dot product of row i with the vector.","effect_on_target":"For [speed], multiplication sends the unique coordinate v(0) to speed*v(0).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Module.Basis","meaning":"An indexed module basis, giving unique finite linear coordinates for every vector.","effect_on_target":"The eigenvectors form a real basis of the entire one-component vector space, rather than merely a family of eigenvectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Module.Basis.instFunLike","meaning":"The basis vector at i is the inverse coordinate representation of the finitely supported coordinate vector with entry 1 at i.","effect_on_target":"The eigenvector equation applies to actual basis vectors, which are nonzero and span the space.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing","meaning":"Retains commutative multiplication and additive ring structure while forgetting associativity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"A structure conversion supporting real matrix multiplication without changing its operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplicative commutativity from the indicated ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Continues the structure path to the arithmetic required by matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Retains addition, zero, multiplication and distributive laws while forgetting additive inverses.","effect_on_target":"Supplies finite-sum and product operations for the coefficient action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group with a norm and compatible metric.","effect_on_target":"The generic scalar predicates use this structure, instantiated here by Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive group underlying a normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Provides ordinary subtraction for integral differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"NormedField.toNormedSpace","meaning":"A normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Supports the ordinary real scalar action in derivative predicates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A module over a normed field whose scalar multiplication satisfies the norm bound.","effect_on_target":"The scalar predicates and integrals use real normed vector spaces, with E specialized to Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"The pointwise module structure on functions I → β.","effect_on_target":"The eigenbasis lives in the usual coordinatewise real vector space Fin 1 → Real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"Pi.addCommMonoid","meaning":"Pointwise commutative addition and zero on a function space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the additive structure of coordinate vectors for the eigenbasis assertion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"Real.commRing","meaning":"The usual real commutative ring with its addition, multiplication, negation, subtraction and numerals.","effect_on_target":"Fixes ordinary real arithmetic in characteristic shifts, matrix products and equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"Real.instAdd","meaning":"Real addition.","effect_on_target":"The shifted spatial coordinate is the ordinary sum x+speed*t.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"Real.instAddCommMonoid","meaning":"The real additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supports real coordinate addition and the module underlying the eigenbasis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The real commutative semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports the self-algebra and its multiplication-based scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"Real.semiring","meaning":"The real semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides scalar arithmetic for real modules and bases.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Extracts the pseudometric underlying a seminormed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the topology used by derivatives in the generic scalar predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"Semiring.toModule","meaning":"A semiring acting on itself by multiplication as a module.","effect_on_target":"Identifies scalar multiplication of real derivative values with real multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","meaning":"Extracts subtraction from a subtraction-and-negation monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the subtraction operation in the integral balance.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses a type's addition for homogeneous heterogeneous addition.","effect_on_target":"Resolves scalar and vector sums to their respective usual additions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"instHSMul","meaning":"Uses the supplied scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Resolves eigenvalue and speed scalar actions without changing their meaning.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses a type's subtraction for homogeneous heterogeneous subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the subtractions in the conservation identity to real subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"intervalIntegral","meaning":"The integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], with respect to the specified measure.","effect_on_target":"All interval integrals are oriented; reversed endpoints negate them and equal endpoints give zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Builds the commutative subtraction structure of an additive commutative group using its existing addition, negation and subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Supports the canonical zero and subtraction structures of scalar derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"AddCommMagma.toAdd","meaning":"Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same addition used in derivative-value sums.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup","meaning":"Retains associative commutative addition while forgetting the designated identity.","effect_on_target":"Part of the unchanged additive structure of real values and coordinate vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma","meaning":"Retains commutative addition while forgetting associativity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition for the derivative equations through a structure projection.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Retains addition, zero and their identity laws.","effect_on_target":"Provides the zero appearing in scalar and vector equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Extracts the zero element from an addition-and-zero structure.","effect_on_target":"The zero in derivative equations is the additive zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Extracts the addition and zero operations.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the additive zero used by the equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication distributing over addition and preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the same linear scalar action used for speed and eigenvalues.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Retains a scalar action and its preservation of zero.","effect_on_target":"A structure projection supporting the scalar multiplication in derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"DivisionSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts semiring operations from a division semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies ordinary real scalar arithmetic to derivative-related modules.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Forgets definiteness of an extended norm while preserving the extended seminorm and commutative addition.","effect_on_target":"Supports integral-related additive structures without changing real integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition and zero in the structures used for integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets commutativity while retaining extended seminorm and additive monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"A structure projection for integration, with no extra hypothesis on q.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts addition and zero from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides the additive operations used by integral expressions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"Field.toSemifield","meaning":"Retains the field's semiring operations and multiplicative division structure while forgetting additive inverses as requirements.","effect_on_target":"A structure conversion on Real; it does not restrict real values to nonnegative values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"HasDerivAt","meaning":"The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the full neighborhood at that point with that point fixed as base.","effect_on_target":"Requires ordinary two-sided derivatives of each one-variable slice, not one-sided derivatives or values of a totalized derivative operator.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the distributive multiplicative scalar action underlying a module.","effect_on_target":"Supplies scalar multiplication used in the derivative equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"NegZeroClass.toZero","meaning":"Extracts the zero from a structure whose negation preserves zero.","effect_on_target":"Identifies the scalar equation's zero with the ordinary additive zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Extracts commutative addition and zero from the indicated semiring structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides finite summation for matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the norm and metric while retaining commutative ring operations without a designated identity.","effect_on_target":"Preserves real arithmetic along an instance path used in analytic expressions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Forgets associativity of multiplication as a requirement while preserving all operations.","effect_on_target":"Supports the arithmetic structure required by matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField","meaning":"Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real normed-field structure for derivative scalar actions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supports derivatives and integral differences with the usual real addition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Equips a normed additive commutative group with its corresponding extended norm and additive commutative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Connects the real norm to the integration structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains normed commutative ring operations while forgetting the designated multiplicative identity.","effect_on_target":"Preserves real arithmetic and metric along an analytic structure path.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"NormedField.toField","meaning":"Extracts the field underlying a normed field.","effect_on_target":"Provides ordinary real field operations for the derivative structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"The pointwise additive commutative group on a function space.","effect_on_target":"The one-component field and its derivative witnesses are vectors with coordinatewise additive operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D115","name":"Pi.instAdd","meaning":"Function addition is defined coordinatewise by (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).","effect_on_target":"The vector equation reduces to its unique scalar coordinate equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D116","name":"Pi.instZero","meaning":"The zero function has value zero at every coordinate.","effect_on_target":"The right side of the vector derivative equation is the one-component zero vector.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D117","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology on a function space, induced by all coordinate evaluations.","effect_on_target":"Vector derivatives use the product topology; for Fin 1 this is the topology of one real coordinate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D118","name":"Real.instMonoid","meaning":"The multiplicative monoid of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supports the ordinary multiplicative scalar action, including zero scalars.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D119","name":"Real.instRing","meaning":"The real ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides unchanged real arithmetic for inherited module structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D120","name":"Ring.toSemiring","meaning":"Extracts semiring operations from a ring.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real module structure without changing the state domain.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D121","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","meaning":"Extracts scalar multiplication from a zero-preserving scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar operation in speed • qx.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D122","name":"Semifield.toDivisionSemiring","meaning":"Retains division-semiring structure while forgetting multiplicative commutativity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"A structural conversion preserving real multiplication and its scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D123","name":"Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring","meaning":"Retains semiring addition and multiplication while forgetting the designated multiplicative identity.","effect_on_target":"Supports the finite arithmetic of matrix-vector products.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D124","name":"SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass","meaning":"Retains zero, negation and the fact that negation fixes zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the canonical zero used in the scalar derivative equation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D125","name":"SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the subtraction structure.","effect_on_target":"Part of the unchanged additive and zero structure of scalar derivative values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D126","name":"SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid","meaning":"Builds subtraction and negation structure including the law that negation fixes zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the standard zero through the additive structure used by the scalar predicate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D127","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains commutative addition and zero while forgetting inverses as requirements.","effect_on_target":"Supports module and vector addition with the original operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D128","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Retains the additive group while forgetting commutativity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supplies subtraction-related structures for the same real and vector values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D129","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Retains addition and zero while forgetting commutativity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Supports scalar-action and zero structures without altering the proposition.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D130","name":"ContinuousSMul","meaning":"Joint continuity of the map (scalar,vector) ↦ scalar • vector.","effect_on_target":"A structural prerequisite for the derivative predicates, supplied automatically for the scalar and function spaces.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D131","name":"DistribMulAction.toMulAction","meaning":"Retains the monoid scalar action while forgetting its additive distributivity as a requirement.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real scalar action used in the derivative predicates.","status":"understood"},
